config_entries.label: Update Interval
config_entries.description: The interval for updating acceleration sensors. Defaults to `10s`.

config_entries.label: CS Pin
config_entries.description: The chip select pin.

config_entries.label: Mode
config_entries.description: Pin mode flags (input / output / pullup / pulldown / open_drain). Combine flags as needed — e.g. input + pullup for a button pulled to VCC.

config_entries.label: Input
config_entries.description: Set the input mode flag.

config_entries.label: Output
config_entries.description: Set the output mode flag.

config_entries.label: Pullup
config_entries.description: Set the pullup mode flag.

config_entries.label: Pulldown
config_entries.description: Set the pulldown mode flag.

config_entries.label: Open Drain
config_entries.description: Set the open drain mode flag.

config_entries.label: Inverted
config_entries.description: Invert the logical level. ``true`` swaps high/low in software so an active-low button reads as active when grounded.

config_entries.label: ID
config_entries.description: Manually specify the ID of the hub. Needed when more than one sensor is configured, so the platforms below can refer to it with `lis2dw12_id`.

config_entries.label: Calibration
config_entries.description: Zero position offsets per axis.

config_entries.label: Offset X
config_entries.description: X-axis zero position calibration, in m/s². From -4.5 to 4.5. Defaults to `0`.

config_entries.label: Offset Y
config_entries.description: Y-axis zero position calibration, in m/s². From -4.5 to 4.5. Defaults to `0`.

config_entries.label: Offset Z
config_entries.description: Z-axis zero position calibration, in m/s². From -4.5 to 4.5. Defaults to `0`.

config_entries.label: Filter Bandwidth
config_entries.description: Digital filter bandwidth. One of `odr_div_2`, `odr_div_4`, `odr_div_10`, `odr_div_20`. Defaults to `odr_div_2`.

config_entries.label: Low Noise
config_entries.description: Enable low-noise mode. Defaults to `false`.

config_entries.label: Output Data Rate
config_entries.description: Output data rate. One of `1.6Hz`, `12.5Hz`, `25Hz`, `50Hz`, `100Hz`, `200Hz`, `400Hz`, `800Hz`, `1600Hz`. Defaults to `100Hz`. `1.6Hz` is only available in the low-power modes, and `400Hz` and above only in `high_performance`.

config_entries.label: Power Mode
config_entries.description: Operating power mode. One of `high_performance`, `low_power_1`, `low_power_2`, `low_power_3`, `low_power_4`. Mode `low_power_1` uses 12-bit resolution, all others use 14-bit. Defaults to `high_performance`.

config_entries.label: Range
config_entries.description: The range of the sensor measurements. One of `2G`, `4G`, `8G`, `16G`. Defaults to `2G` which means it picks up accelerations between `-2g` and `2g`.

config_entries.label: Transform
config_entries.description: Remaps the axes of the acceleration sensors to match how the board is mounted. The orientation text sensor always reports the chip's own axes.

config_entries.label: Mirror X
config_entries.description: Mirror X-axis. Defaults to `false`.

config_entries.label: Mirror Y
config_entries.description: Mirror Y-axis. Defaults to `false`.

config_entries.label: Mirror Z
config_entries.description: Mirror Z-axis. Defaults to `false`.

config_entries.label: Swap Xy
config_entries.description: Swap X and Y axis. Defaults to `false`.
